title: Consolidate Console insight tiles into compact skeleton; scope reduction and degrade plan
creator: Ava Martinez
description: PRD addendum: Given time and telemetry constraints, we will deliver a compressed 'skeleton' of insight tiles for the Redwood Console initial observability surface. This ticket defines which widgets are in the skeleton, the graceful degradation behavior when telemetry is missing or rate-limited, and the acceptance criteria for launch. The goal is to ship a usable, low-cost set of panels that surface route-level latency, recent errors, and per-route cost delta while deferring heavy traces and deep historical rollups to later phases.
scope_changes: Remove full-length trace waterfall viewer from alpha; replace with single-sample trace link and summary metadata
Limit dashboard time-range presets to 1h and 24h; remove 7d/30d aggregation in initial release
Aggregate cost breakdown to top-5 routes only; omit token-level cost drilldown until post-ALPHA
Disable per-token trace sampling and detailed sequence-level diagnostics for the MVP; enable lightweight span-level counts
Consolidate three existing insight cards into a single compact 'route snapshot' tile (latency p50/p95, error rate, cost delta)
decisions: Adopt compact tiles to minimize client rendering and telemetry payloads
Prefer server-side pre-aggregation for p95 calculation to reduce front-end compute
Expose a shallow 'Open Trace' link that opens a dedicated trace viewer in a later release; immediate behavior: show last-sampled trace id and a 1-line summary
Prioritize route-level cost delta over detailed token breakdown to keep backend compute and cost low
Provide a feature-flag gated path for customers on Dedicated to enable extended retention and deeper traces
acceptance_criteria: Route snapshot tile renders within 300ms on a mid-tier machine (80th percentile)
p50 and p95 latency, error rate, and cost delta are displayed for a selected time-range (1h / 24h)
When telemetry is degraded or absent, tiles show transparent 'degraded data' state with next-steps and link to explain rate limits
Top-5 routes cost breakdown matches backend export within 5% for the 24h range
Feature flag exists and can be toggled by Console team to enable/disable detailed traces per org
E2E tests covering degraded-state messaging, tile rendering, and cost delta calculations are present in the test suite
tradeoffs: User research indicates deeper traces are valuable, but we defer to reduce launch risk and cost
Simplified time ranges may frustrate power users but significantly reduces compute and card count
Server-side aggregations lower front-end complexity but shift compute to backend which needs capacity gating
Compact tiles reduce signal fidelity; mitigation: preserve a prominent link to request full telemetry (admin/enterprise only)
dependencies: ENG-2176: cost-aggregator pipeline for per-route deltas
ENG-1930: feature-flagging infra for console toggles
PM-8124: alignment on telemetry retention SLAs (input to degrade messaging)
notes: Spike completed 2026-03-05 confirmed 3x lower client memory usage with compact cards
Initial user interviews (n=7) show preference for latency and cost at-a-glance over deep trace UX
Ops requested explicit degrade messaging to reduce alert noise; included in acceptance criteria
Plan: ship skeleton as default for hosted customers; enable expanded cardset via beta opt-in for Dedicated customers
